title: Delivery Note — the stock-committing selling document
description: A delivery note records goods leaving a warehouse against an order. It is the document where the selling cycle touches stock, which is why against_sales_order is required: a delivery that fulfils no order is a stock adjustment, and the model has stock-entry for that. The stock half of the transactional spine (ERP-03, #648) reads this document to decide what the stock ledger receives.

party.description: Link to the customer the goods are delivered to.

against_sales_order.description: The sales order this delivery fulfils. Required: fulfilment is the document's reason to exist, and a stock movement with no commitment behind it belongs to stock-entry instead.

warehouse.description: The default source warehouse; a line may override it.

lines.description: The delivered lines. Each line's warehouse names the stock the movement is taken from.

total.description: The delivered value, which the invoice is raised against.

harvest: the delivery note field surface (against sales order, warehouse, delivered lines)
the fulfilment link from a delivery back to the order it satisfies
delivery as the point where the selling cycle commits stock
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream delivery note doctype, re-expressed. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
